methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve current-market indoor air quality monitors. Specs and prices were independently re-verified (2026-06-20) against official manufacturer pages (airthings.com, getawair.com, iqair.com/us, aranet.com, getuhoo.com, evehome.com, www2.purpleair.com, temtopus.com) and topical retailers/reviews (Amazon, Walmart, airdetectortools.com, breathesafeair.com, techhive.com, housefresh.com). Booleans under specKeys indicate confirmed presence (true) or confirmed absence (false); null means presence could not be confirmed. priceUsd reflects the published US list/MSRP for the exact named model at time of access; promotional/sale or street pricing is noted in priceNote. Where the exact named draft source URL 404'd, it was replaced with a working, topical URL and noted in provenance. accessedAt 2026-06-20 throughout.

products.name: Airthings View Plus
products.priceNote: MSRP, single unit; frequently discounted (~$235-265 promos seen)

products.name: AirGradient ONE (I-9PSL)
products.priceNote: Official AirGradient page lists "USD 230.00" for the fully assembled AirGradient ONE (Model I-9PSL); the kit version is "USD 138.00". breathesafeair.com review corroborates "$138 vs $230" ($138 DIY kit / $230 assembled). priceUsd reflects the fully assembled named model.

specs.power: USB-C plug-in; requires >2A 5V USB power plug (not included)

products.provenance: The official AirGradient indoor page's Technical Data table confirms the exact model "I-9PSL (AirGradient ONE, 9th Generation)" with SenseAir S8/S88 NDIR CO2, Plantower PMS5003 PM2.5, Sensirion SGP41 TVOC/NOx and SHT40 temp/humidity sensors, a "OLED display 1.3 inch (I2C 128x64px)", 2.4 GHz WiFi, and power via USB-C requiring a ">2A 5V USB A Power Plug" (not included); it lists the fully assembled unit at "USD 230.00" (kit "USD 138.00"). No radon sensor is present (the full sensor list is enumerated on both pages). The breathesafeair.com review (published 24 Nov 2025, updated 27 Apr 2026) corroborates the same sensor lineup, the 1.3-inch OLED display, WiFi connectivity, and pricing ("$138 vs $230"), and independently confirms the model identity by referencing the "I-9PSL-DE" dashboard hardware selection. No explicit calendar release year is stated on either page, so releaseDate and release_year are left null.

products.name: Qingping Air Quality Monitor Gen 2
products.priceNote: Official Qingping store (shop.qingping.co) regular price $149.99 USD; corroborated by airpurifierfirst.com ("$149.99 at Amazon") and breathesafeair ("around $150").

specs.power: 1800 mAh Li-ion battery (~3 hr) or USB-C (5 V/1 A)

products.provenance: The official Qingping store (shop.qingping.co) lists the device as "Qingping Air Monitor 2" at regular price $149.99 USD and publishes the full spec sheet: 7 metrics (temperature, humidity, CO2 400~9999 ppm, PM2.5/PM10 0~999 μg/m³, eTVOC, noise), "4'' IPS touchscreen" at "Resolution: 720 × 720", Mi Home / Qingping+ app over Wi-Fi, and a Lithium Ion "1800mAh/3.7V" battery with "Power port: USB-C" / "Power input: 5V⎓1A" (FAQ: runs "about 3 hours" on battery). Model identity was confirmed via Amazon (ASIN B0CZ85RT6C), which sells the same device in the US as "Qingping Air Quality Monitor Gen 2" with Part Number/Model "CGS2" (Qingping Technology Beijing) — i.e. the global "Air Monitor 2" name equals the US-retail "Air Quality Monitor Gen 2". The dated airpurifierfirst.com hands-on review (9 Dec 2025) corroborates the $149.99 price, the 4-inch IPS touchscreen, USB-C + battery power, and the GrandWay/Sensirion SCD40/SGP40 sensor suite; no radon sensor exists on any source. Release year is not explicitly stated on any fetched page, so release_year and releaseDate are left null.

products.name: IKEA Vindstyrka
products.priceNote: US price $49.99 stated verbatim in the BreatheSafeAir hands-on review (published 6 Oct 2023, updated 23 Apr 2026); the IKEA official product-page URLs (US/UK) redirected to the generic catalog without rendering a live price, so no manufacturer list price could be captured.

specs.display_screen: Digital display showing PM2.5, temperature, humidity, and TVOC trend arrow

products.provenance: The official IKEA Global newsroom page (source) confirms the exact model — VINDSTYRKA, a smart indoor air quality sensor — with a display that shows PM2.5 levels, humidity, temperature and TVOC, connectivity via the DIRIGERA hub (readable in the IKEA Home smart app) or the STARKVIND purifier, and availability in all IKEA markets starting April 2023 (announced 14 February 2023). BreatheSafeAir's dated hands-on review (corroboration; published 6 Oct 2023, updated 23 Apr 2026) confirms the US price of $49.99, the Sensirion SEN54 all-in-one sensor package (PM2.5, tVOC, temperature, relative humidity — explicitly no CO2 and no radon), USB Type-C power with no internal battery, and the qualitative TVOC trend-arrow display. The IKEA US/UK product URLs redirected to the generic catalog (no live price rendered), so the official newsroom is used as the manufacturer source and the price is taken verbatim from the review; both pages describe the standalone Vindstyrka (not the STARKVIND/VINDSTYRKA purifier bundle).

products.provenance: Official SwitchBot US product page confirms this exact model, "SwitchBot Meter Pro CO2 Monitor" — a 5-in-1 monitor tracking CO2 (Sensirion NDIR, 400-9999 ppm), temperature, humidity, time and comfort (no PM2.5/VOC/radon), with a large LCD display, BLE + SwitchBot App connectivity (Alexa/Google/SmartThings/IFTTT/Siri), 2 AA battery or Type-C (5 V 1 A) power, and list price $69.99. HomeTechHacker's dated review (Nov 27, 2024) corroborates the $69.99 price and explicitly distinguishes this CO2 model from the non-CO2 "SwitchBot Meter Pro," confirming model identity. products.name: Govee Smart Air Quality Monitor (H5106)
products.priceNote: Govee US store MSRP $59.99 (struck-through original), currently on sale $34.99 per us.govee.com; TechHive review cites list price "$60".

specs.display_screen: LED display (PM2.5/temp/humidity or clock) with 4-level color air-quality indicator light
specs.power: USB-C wired (AC power); no built-in battery

products.provenance: Official Govee US product page lists "Model: H5106", price "$34.99 $59.99" (sale over original MSRP), and confirms it monitors temperature, humidity, and PM2.5, with Govee Home app data via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi and USB-C ("Type-C Cable Required") power. TechHive's dated review (Dec 16, 2022) corroborates the exact model: it "runs on AC power (via USB-C)", has a bright front display of temperature/humidity/PM2.5 plus a color LED indicator, lists MSRP "$60", and explicitly notes it does NOT track carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, or VOC — hence co2/voc/radon set to false. The Amazon listing (ASIN B0BC7NKJ2Z, Mfr Part Number H5106101) further confirms the H5106 identity, the clock/PM2.5 LED display with a 4-level air-quality indicator, and no built-in battery. priceUsd set to the $59.99 MSRP (currently discounted to $34.99). Verified 2026-07-10.
